messages:
li: noticed mkdocs linkcheck failing on main -> bunch of fragment links resolving to the wrong section after the mdx upgrade.

ci-bot: build: docs/mkdocs: linkcheck failed (exit 2). 15 broken fragments. full log: https://ci.redwood/example/6012 :warning:

nova: samples from the log: 
```
WARNING: broken link: ../reference/client#usage -> resolves to first 'Usage' heading in page, not the specific subheading -> 404
WARNING: broken link: ../tutorials/deploy#tips -> duplicate slug: both 'Tips' and 'Tips (advanced)' normalized to #tips
```

patrick: ah this is the duplicate-slug bug. mdx slugifier collapses punctuation and parens so "Tips (advanced)" -> tips, same as "Tips". linkcheck flags cross-page links that expect the more specific one.

li: two proposed fixes: 1) add explicit header ids for ambiguous headings (best short-term), 2) adjust mkdocs slugify config or post-process AST to keep uniqueness (bigger change).

nova: i'm for explicit ids on the pages that CI flagged. small, surgical, and reviewers can eyeball. e.g. `## Tips (advanced) {#tips-advanced}` and leave plain `## Tips {#tips}`.

patrick: +1. also add a CONTRIBUTING note recommending explicit ids for repeated headings across pages. avoids future collisions.

ci-bot: note: linkcheck will re-run on the PR branch.

li: i'll open a tiny PR touching only the 5 files in the log and add ids and a CONTRIBUTING blurb. will include a short script `scripts/find_duplicate_slugs.py` that reads headings and reports collisions so reviewers can confirm.

nova: small UX nit: prefer ascii kebab-case ids with context, like `tips-advanced` not `tips_adv`. keeps it consistent.

patrick: while we're at it, consider adding a linter step that fails PRs if a page contains duplicate generated slugs. that would catch this early. file a follow-up issue if you want to keep this PR minimal.

li: will keep PR minimal. created branch `docs/anchor-dup-fix` and PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4401 1 files changed, includes script and contributing update.

lighthouse-bot: suggestion: add a tiny CI job to run `scripts/find_duplicate_slugs.py` and post collisions as a PR comment. helps guide non-docs authors.

ci-bot: re-run queued for PR 4401...

nova: tested locally: mkdocs build + linkcheck now passes for the touched files. i also spot-checked the staging site to confirm the fragments jump to the intended subheading.

patrick: nice. i left one minor id rename suggestion in the PR (make the id more descriptive).

li: updated per feedback and pushed. thanks all. will merge once CI green.

(last) nova: merging on green and then i'll trigger a full site deploy to make sure search indexing picks up the new anchors. will post final status here. :rocket:
